decisions.reason: The quoted sentence explicitly states 'mutant miniswine present with retinal degeneration and motor abnormalities, similar to deficits seen in humans diagnosed with the disease.' The phrase 'similar to deficits seen in humans diagnosed with the disease' directly connects these phenotypes to CLN3 disease (the disease in question as established throughout the abstract). The observation is about humans with CLN3 disease presenting with retinal degeneration as a phenotype.

The quoted sentence 'Progressive pathology and neuron loss is observed in various regions of the CLN3Δex7/8 miniswine brain and retina' describes pathology in a CLN3 disease model (CLN3Δex7/8 miniswine). The surrounding abstract establishes that this miniswine model 'recapitulates the most common human pathogenic variant' of CLN3 disease. Neuron loss is presented as a progressive pathological feature of the disease. This is inferred rather than direct only because the quote refers to the model rather than humans, but the abstract explicitly states the model recapitulates human disease.
